proposed_rules.trigger: A node tagged [region] appears as a sibling far from its logical container (including near page root), with content matching an FAQ answer, embed, or panel elsewhere in the tree that lacks a matching child.
proposed_rules.decision: Re-associate the [region] node with its nearest matching placeholder/question by content adjacency and vertical position instead of treating it as separate/lost content; merge into the parent block's row.
proposed_rules.rationale: The page-tree capture promotes absolutely/fixed-positioned descendants out of their DOM parent to preserve visual position, fragmenting single content items (FAQ Q&A pairs) across non-adjacent nodes (rc2c12c2c7..c16, rc4). Without reattachment, answers are lost or double-counted.

provenance.evidence: C171 rc2c10c2c11..c16 and rc4 [region] answers positioned outside rc2c10's list order

proposed_rules.trigger: A section-sized [bg:color]/[bg:image] container with no descendant text, sitting directly under a 'Watch a Demo'/video-style heading.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag as an embedded video/demo widget that failed to render text at capture time; route to Phase 2 for iframe/video src extraction rather than treating as decorative background.
proposed_rules.rationale: Distinguishes this narrow case from the confirmed underrendered-list-zone rule (which targets listing/card grids); a video embed needs different Phase 2 handling.

provenance.evidence: C171 rc2c3c2 [bg:color] 1140x701 directly under 'Watch a Demo' heading
